base: Use case: identity-preserve / illustration-story. Generate one finished 16:9 single still, not a collage or storyboard. Normal adult proportions, polished 2D anime visual-novel CG; no chibi, no real people. Reference 1 is Claude identity only: long orange hair, amber eyes, sunflower and black ribbon, exact cream/orange/black ornate dress, one brown patterned book. Reference 2 is DeepSeek identity only: long blue hair, blue eyes, white maid cap, blue/white maid dress, exactly one attached dark-blue whale tail with two flukes, no horns or dragon tail. Reference 3 is the approved project's room/style/composition: warm sunset window, cream floral couch, bookshelves, plants and sunflowers. Adapt camera framing for each shot without changing the room design. Keep DeepSeek on screen LEFT and Claude on screen RIGHT in every shot. Exactly two clearly adult women, two arms each, anatomically traceable shoulders/elbows/wrists, coherent separate hair and clothing silhouettes. They are fond of each other: gaze, shoulder distance and subtle contrasting expressions carry the romance. No text, logo, UI, watermark, third person or floating hands. Generous frame margin, full heads, both hands, whale tail and shoe silhouettes visible when framing is full-body. Warm affectionate SFW romantic slice of life; no kissing. Preserve the original costumes and facial features closely. Do not copy the hair-touch pose of reference 3; follow the new shot specification.

shots: S1-offer

Wide fixed eye-level room view, full-body both women. The cream floral couch under the window has an empty cushion on its LEFT. DeepSeek stands just left of it, looking from Claude to the empty seat, quietly expectant. Claude stands next to the RIGHT end, facing slightly toward DeepSeek, inviting with her own RIGHT hand open and low over the vacant cushion; her LEFT forearm alone securely supports her ONE small open brown book at waist level. Her right arm stays separate from the book. Claude gives a composed welcoming half-smile. DeepSeek's two hands rest together near her own apron. Tail behind her curves to frame left, flukes separated. No bowl, no extra chair.
S2-sit-close

Same camera, room and exact couch as S1. Both women have now sat on the same couch cushion area, DeepSeek LEFT, Claude RIGHT, shoulders about a hand-width apart, bodies gently angled together. Feet on floor and skirts naturally draped. Claude's SAME book remains OPEN on her own lap, supported only by her LEFT hand; her right hand rests on her own skirt. DeepSeek's two hands remain on her own apron, not on Claude or the book. DeepSeek smiles openly at being invited; Claude looks at her with a restrained warm smile. Whale tail stays attached behind DeepSeek and rests along couch left outside their legs. No bowl.
S3-book-close

Same seated positions, same fixed camera, same room and couch. Claude has gently CLOSED the SAME brown book on her own lap with her RIGHT hand resting on its top and LEFT hand supporting its bottom. She leans just a little closer without touching DeepSeek's face. DeepSeek glances sideways toward Claude with a faint blush and small smile, hands on her own apron; shoulder gap smaller but distinct silhouettes remain. Both feet remain on floor. Tail rests low at the left, connected and quiet. No bowl, no hug, no other objects.
S1-offer-bowl

Medium-wide fixed eye-level room view, full heads to shoes and whale tail included. Both women stand near the approved cream couch. DeepSeek LEFT, Claude RIGHT facing each other at conversational distance. DeepSeek proudly offers ONE small white porcelain bowl containing plain white rice at waist/chest height, held securely with her TWO hands, one supporting underneath and the other at the near side. Claude holds her ONE CLOSED brown book securely against her LEFT ribs with LEFT forearm; her RIGHT hand is relaxed near her own waist, not touching the bowl yet. Claude's expression is gently surprised and interested, DeepSeek pleased and inviting. No spoon, chopsticks, table bowl, extra book or second bowl.
S2-hand-bowl

Same standing positions, fixed camera, clothing, room, bowl and book as S1. Freeze a physically clear MID-HANDOVER: exactly ONE white rice bowl between them. DeepSeek's LEFT palm supports its bottom and her RIGHT hand still steadies its left-facing rim. Claude's own RIGHT hand comes from her RIGHT shoulder via a visible elbow and lightly cups the bowl's opposite side; these are the only THREE hands near the bowl. Claude's LEFT arm remains at her own torso securely holding her SAME CLOSED brown book under her left forearm. No finger fusion, no arm crossing or hands emerging from the book. DeepSeek looks expectantly at Claude; Claude's eyes soften, calm and appreciative. Do not feed mouths or use spoons.
S3-settle

Same camera and standing positions. The handover has FINISHED: the ONE white rice bowl is now held securely ONLY in Claude's own RIGHT hand at waist height, fingers supporting its base/side. Claude's LEFT forearm still secures the SAME CLOSED brown book against her left torso. DeepSeek has fully withdrawn both hands to rest visibly together at her own apron; she is pleased and a little bashful. Claude gives her a small grateful smile, looking at DeepSeek rather than at camera. Bowl, rice and book retain size and shape. No eating, no spoon, no duplicated bowl or extra arm.
S1-open-book

Medium-wide fixed eye-level room view, heads to below knees, complete hands and tail flukes in frame. Both women seated on the SAME cream couch, DeepSeek LEFT and Claude RIGHT. Claude holds her ONE OPEN brown book on her own lap with her LEFT hand under the spine. Her RIGHT index finger lightly points to one page; a thin plain red ribbon bookmark attached at the spine lies visibly along the page, no readable lettering. DeepSeek leans slightly toward the page, interested but not touching. DeepSeek's two hands stay on her own apron. Claude is thoughtfully explaining; DeepSeek curious. Their shoulders remain distinct and whale tail rests visibly on the left.
S2-blocked-peek

Same camera, couch, positions, one book and hands as S1. DeepSeek has leaned closer to see the page, her eyes peeking shyly over the raised left edge of the SAME OPEN book; only the very bottom of her face is partly hidden by its edge, both eyes and hair ornaments visible. Claude has raised the book slightly with her LEFT hand underneath its spine; her RIGHT hand rests on its outer right page edge and stays clearly separate from DeepSeek's cheek. Claude has a tiny amused side glance toward DeepSeek, who looks mildly flustered but interested. DeepSeek's hands remain on her own lap. No second book, no full-face occlusion, no contact between hands and face.
S3-bookmark

Same camera and seated positions, shoulders close but not interlocked. The SAME book rests partly OPEN on Claude's lap, LEFT palm supporting its spine. Claude's RIGHT thumb and index finger place the SAME thin red ribbon bookmark between the pages; the remaining right fingers are relaxed and anatomically clear. The book is not yet fully shut, so placement is readable. DeepSeek sits back a little, a faint blush and a soft side glance at Claude, hands on her own apron. Claude smiles with composed warmth while looking down at the bookmark. Both faces, hands and tail visible, no new props.
S1-fish-approach

Medium-wide fixed eye-level room view, full bodies and tail. Both seated on the SAME cream floral couch, DeepSeek LEFT and Claude RIGHT. DeepSeek initiates a gentle lean toward Claude's near shoulder while keeping her own two hands on her apron. Faces still separated by about one head width; no face or hand contact. Claude holds her ONE CLOSED brown book with both hands on her own lap and has not yet noticed, eyes calmly down toward the cover. DeepSeek has a playful fond small smile, whale tail's attached low curve gathers gently toward her own left ankle, never between their legs.
S2-claude-startle

Same fixed camera, couch, clothing and positions. DeepSeek is now a little nearer Claude's shoulder but there is still a small clear gap, no contact. Claude has JUST noticed and turns her eyes and head slightly toward DeepSeek, eyebrows raised a touch, lips barely parted in a quiet surprised pause, not shouting. Her two hands still hold the SAME CLOSED brown book on her own lap without reaching out. DeepSeek's two hands remain visibly on her own apron; she pauses with a small shy smile. Their expressions are deliberately different, no symmetric blush, no hug or extra hands. Tail remains attached and low.
S3-nod-settle

Same fixed camera, couch and positions. Claude has recovered from the brief surprise: chin lowered a little in an accepting small nod, gentle composed smile toward DeepSeek. Her SAME CLOSED book is drawn a little closer against her own lap with BOTH hands, not disappearing or changing hands. DeepSeek stays near her shoulder with a slight blush, looks away for a moment then a soft sideways glance; both hands on her own apron. Faces and shoulders remain separate, no contact or embrace. Whale tail settles low beside DeepSeek with its two flukes clear, no dragon features.
